pixelReview.reviewMethod: Agent directly viewed all current 204 caption crops on nine original-resolution sheets, 28 composition frames on seven sheets, and every narrated beat on all 14 final explanation sheets with view_image.
notes: All 204 captions are readable, bottom-center, square opaque white boxes with forest shadows. No clipped or displaced cue was observed.

Full-screen existing-game actions alternate with independent white Manim mathematical explanations. XY coordinates, ordered boundaries and planar partitions intentionally remain in their stated XY plane; no claim that flat cards are projected 2.5D.
The 3-4-5 triangle shows G=(4/3,1), I=(1,1), O=(2,1.5); r=1 and R=2.5. The right-triangle O lies on the hypotenuse, and the obtuse example O=(2,-1) lies outside.
The L boundary remains ordered and excludes the upper-right notch. Mixed turn signs, the 720-degree sum, failed arbitrary fan and signed 7 versus absolute 16 are visibly distinguished.

Ear removal preserves original indices and updates neighbors. Four positive triangles have areas 2,1.5,1.5,2, sum 7; pixels show no filled notch, overlap or omitted L region, matching the independent 2021-sample check.
Validity precedes quality; tiny-height triangles and scale-aware length/area tolerances are distinguished. No generalized hole-bridging claim.

The original two-second cat intro and ten-second original member row images preserve profiles, handles and badges. Coaching URL and original channel logo remain visible; truncated handles remain a human review item.
